Container.Name: bants-server
Container.Overview: Self-hosted backend for a WhatsApp-style messaging app: accounts, friend codes, chats, groups, media and push notifications.

Config.Name: Invite code
Config.Description: New users must enter this to sign up. Leave blank to let anyone register.

Config.Name: Allow registration
Config.Description: Set to false to stop new sign-ups entirely.

Config.Name: Max upload (MB)
Config.Description: Largest photo/video/file a user can send.

Config.Name: FCM service account
Config.Description: Path inside the container to your Firebase service-account JSON, e.g. /data/firebase-service-account.json. Leave blank to disable push.
